headline: Mexico Exports Reach $77.8 Billion Driven by 94.7% Surge in AI Electronics
summary: Mexico's total exports reached $77.79 billion in September, buoyed by a 94.7% surge in electrical and electronic equipment shipments linked to global AI demand. Meanwhile, the national petroleum trade deficit expanded.
why: Mexico is a prime beneficiary of nearshoring and global tech hardware manufacturing supply chain integration into North America.
